name.zh: 莉夏赠予路克斯的机攻壳剑

periods.description: The Sword Device in a new sheath that Lisha offers Lux during his formal admission ceremony while his Wyvern Sword Device is still being repaired.

details.ceremonial_role: symbol of Lisha's royal order accepting Lux into the academy

history: Presented by Lisha in the headmistress office after Lux recovers from Bahamut overuse
